description: COMPOSITE. Built at WSK Mielec in April 1956 as Lim-2 works number 1B 15-027 (tactical 1527). Served 29. PLM Orneta from 24 April 1956; Bydgoszcz 1960-1963; rebuilt to Lim-2R reconnaissance standard at LZR nr 4 Warszawa in 1964; 21. PLRT Sochaczew from 10 June 1964; WSL Dęblin by 1972; then COSSTWL Oleśnica. Given to the town in December 1976 as a gift of the Polish People's Air Force and mounted on a steel frame built by the Andoria engine works. A 2015 survey at the Polish Aviation Museum in Kraków established that only the forward fuselage is 1B 15-027; the rear fuselage and wings come from MiG-15/Lim-1 airframes of the 1A series
